title: Feature Request: Change mechanism for determining SMB enablement
symptom: SMB is disabled for Libre 2 users based on the assumption that the input data is too noisy, even though xDrip+ noise suppression can produce a smooth BG curve, and Dexcom G6 users with extended sensor life may have noisier data but are allowed SMB.
cause: The limitation exists because Libre sensors can send false data (typically high value) instead of reporting an error, which is dangerous especially at night when users cannot recognize the situation.
evidence_quote: the issue is not only noisy sensor but situation where Libre sends false data (typicaly high value) instead of reporting error
